text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: I got thrashed, plain and simple. I couldn't afford t'get thrashed, but I did anyhoo…

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: It's 'cause I'm lack'n spirit… If only I'd hung in there longer!
choice_data_list: Let's use that frustration as fuel.
We just have to work harder!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: You're right. I know why I lost. So now I just gotta conquer my weaknesses!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: All righty, time t'buckle down! I'm gonna toughen up, body and soul, and get that next win!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: If I'm weak, I've just gotta get tougher! I'm gonna learn t'stay strong—both on the track and in my head!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: And I'm gonna need your help, Trainer! Then, next time, I'll be able t'hold on tight till vict'ry's mine!
